## Summary

Created the boopada-planner initiative and recorded the 9-piece roadmap as phases, then shipped phase 1 (traveller profile) in commit 237649b.

Built in apps/web: lib/db.ts (SQLite at BOOPADA_DB_PATH, MIGRATIONS array applied on first use, schema_version table), lib/money.ts ({amount_minor, currency} integer minor units, BigInt decimal parsing, no floats), lib/providers.ts (fixture bundle + BOOPADA_NOW clock), lib/reference.ts (currencies and airports the providers know), lib/interests.ts (the seven activity categories), lib/http.ts (ApiError + handle() -> {error:{code,message}}), lib/profile.ts (single-row store + validation), app/api/profile/route.ts, app/api/reference/route.ts, app/profile (server page + client form, data-testid profile-form / profile-save / per-field ids), and a home-page link.

Decisions D1 (money), D2 (interests), D3 (SQLite only through lib/db.ts), D4 (process.getBuiltinModule for node:sqlite). Memories M1 (fx.getRates omits its own base) and M2 (a green build does not prove the app runs). Both are cited in .sofar/repo.md, which now also carries the repo's commands and conventions.

Also: biome.json now excludes .sofar so lint does not trip on generated projections; .gitignore covers sqlite WAL files and data/; README documents the env vars, the money shape, the API and the page.

bun run lint, typecheck, test (25 new tests) and build all pass; the app was started with bun run start and the routes curled, including a JOD budget round-tripping through three minor units.
